segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Katrin and if you've been listening to our recent lessons, you know that we've been talking a lot about food.
segments.zh: 我的名字是卡特琳，如果你一直在听我们最近的课程，你就会知道我们一直在谈论食物。

segments.en: That's right and today we have another lesson all about food from a different country.
segments.zh: 没错，今天我们有另一个关于来自不同国家的食物的教训。

segments.en: Last time we took a look at Mexican food, Chinese food.
segments.zh: 上次我们看墨西哥菜，中国菜。

segments.en: Now we are talking about Indian food.
segments.zh: 现在我们谈论的是印度菜。

segments.en: Okay, Indian food is very famous for being spicy but not all of it is spicy.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度菜以辛辣而闻名，但并非所有食物都是辣的。

segments.en: Let's take a listen to today's dialogue and find out just what kinds of food you will find at an Indian restaurant.
segments.zh: 让我们听听今天的对话，了解您会在印度餐厅找到什么样的食物。

segments.en: So where is this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
segments.zh: 那么我们要去的神秘餐厅在哪里呢？

segments.en: It's an Indian restaurant.
segments.zh: 那是一家印度餐厅。

segments.en: I know you have never had Indian food so I thought you might want to try it.
segments.zh: 我知道你从来没有吃过印度菜，所以我想你可能想尝尝。

segments.en: That sounds great.
segments.zh: 听起来很棒。

segments.en: I am craving some type of beef dish.
segments.zh: 我渴望某种类型的牛肉菜。

segments.en: Well Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度菜实际上不提供牛肉。

segments.en: You see cows are a sacred animal, a very important element in the Hindu religion so beef is not eaten.
segments.zh: 你看奶牛是一种神圣的动物，是印度教宗教中非常重要的元素，所以不吃牛肉。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So what are we having?
segments.zh: 那么我们有什么？

segments.en: Chicken?
segments.zh: 鸡肉？

segments.en: There are many amazing dishes to choose from.
segments.zh: 有许多令人惊叹的菜肴可供选择。

segments.en: We can have some chicken tikka masala which is an amazing curry.
segments.zh: 可以点一份玛萨拉烤鸡咖喱，味道非常棒。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，但我认为你可以处理它。

segments.en: Sounds good.
segments.zh: 听起来不错。

segments.en: I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
segments.zh: 我一直听说印度香料给食物带来了浓郁的味道。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Also we can have some naan bread which is baked in a tandoori oven.
segments.zh: 我们也可以吃一些在唐杜里烤箱中烘烤的烤饼。

segments.en: Since you don't use any utensils to eat, you can use this bread to scoop up the curry or rice.
segments.zh: 由于您不使用任何餐具吃，因此您可以用这种面包舀起咖喱或米饭。

segments.en: What about veggies?
segments.zh: 蔬菜呢？

segments.en: Oh they have a good variety of vegetable based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable samosas or dal.
segments.zh: 蔬菜类菜肴也有很多，比如菠菜奶酪、蔬菜咖喱角和扁豆咖喱。

segments.en: It all sounds so exquisite.
segments.zh: 这一切听起来都很精致。

segments.en: I can't wait.
segments.zh: 我等不及了。

segments.en: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at a couple of words and phrases here on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，现在让我们来看看这里的语言外卖中的几个单词和短语。

segments.en: In this first Language Takeaway today, we have words that are about the kinds of food we're eating today.
segments.zh: 在今天的第一语言外卖中，我们有关于我们今天吃的食物种类的词语。

segments.en: So the first one, the character said, I am craving some type of beef.
segments.zh: 所以第一个，角色说，我渴望某种类型的牛肉。

segments.en: So to crave something.
segments.zh: 所以渴望一些东西。

segments.en: Okay so that is a verb, to crave and that means that you have a desire, you really want to eat something, to have a particular thing.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个动词，渴望，这意味着你有一个欲望，你真的想吃点东西，有一个特定的东西。

segments.en: That's right but it's particular so it's something specific.
segments.zh: 没错，但它很特别，所以它是特定的东西。

segments.en: For example, pregnant women are famous for craving strange foods like pickles.
segments.zh: 例如，孕妇以渴望泡菜等奇怪食物而闻名。

segments.en: Yeah exactly.
segments.zh: 对，完全正确。

segments.en: So if you say I'm craving some ice cream, you specifically want ice cream or maybe vanilla ice cream.
segments.zh: 所以如果你说我想吃冰淇淋，你特别想要冰淇淋或香草冰淇淋。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And this person wants beef but unfortunately there's no beef at Indian restaurants because cows are what?
segments.zh: 这个人想要牛肉，但不幸的是，印度餐馆没有牛肉，因为牛是什么？

segments.en: Cows are a sacred animal so they are sacred in India.
segments.zh: 牛是一种神圣的动物，所以它们在印度是神圣的。

segments.en: Sacred means special or somehow important in a religious way.
segments.zh: 神圣的意思是在宗教方面特别或以某种方式重要的意思。

segments.en: For example, you could say this is a very sacred place so please don't use cameras or phones and take your shoes off.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以说这是一个非常神圣的地方，因此请不要使用相机或手机并脱鞋。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the word sacred refers to something that is religious and very important for that religion.
segments.zh: 所以神圣这个词是指对该宗教具有宗教意义且非常重要的东西。

segments.en: Especially in this occasion we're talking about the Hindu religion.
segments.zh: 尤其是在这个场合，我们谈论的是印度教。

segments.en: Okay so the Hindu religion or Hinduism is a religion that's widely practiced in the world and maybe most commonly found in India.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度教或印度教是一种在世界范围内广泛使用的宗教，可能最常见于印度。

segments.en: So you'll see a lot of Hindu temples in India and people don't eat beef like we said because cows are sacred in the Hindu religion.
segments.zh: 所以你会在印度看到很多印度教寺庙，人们不像我们说的那样吃牛肉，因为牛在印度教中是神圣的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay so now in India or for Indian food, it's common to not use any type of utensil to eat.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在在印度或印度食品中，不使用任何类型的器具吃是很常见的。

segments.en: Okay so you might be wondering what is a utensil?
segments.zh: 好的，您可能想知道什么是器具？

segments.en: I know forks, I know spoons.
segments.zh: 我知道叉子，我知道勺子。

segments.en: Well utensil is the word that describes all forks, spoons and knives, things that you eat with.
segments.zh: 好工具是描述所有叉子、勺子和刀具的词，你吃的东西。

segments.en: Okay so utensils are tools for eating and it's a very general category.
segments.zh: 好的，餐具是吃的工具，它是一个非常普遍的类别。

segments.en: Right exactly.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So utensils are spoons, forks, knives, everything.
segments.zh: 所以餐具是勺子、叉子、刀具，一切。

segments.en: Chopsticks are utensils even.
segments.zh: 筷子甚至是餐具。

segments.en: Okay very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And now since we don't use any utensils, you usually eat with your hand and you scoop up the food, the rice or the curry.
segments.zh: 现在我们不使用任何器皿，你通常用手吃饭，然后舀起食物、米饭或咖喱。

segments.en: Okay to scoop up, this is a verb and usually you use your hands to scoop something.
segments.zh: 可以舀起来，这是一个动词，通常你用手舀东西。

segments.en: So in this case I can use a piece of bread to scoop up or to pick up some food.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我可以用一块面包舀起或捡一些食物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: To scoop up, it usually means that you somehow make a little bowl or a little figure with your hand so that the liquid or the food will fit inside, kind of like a little scoop.
segments.zh: 舀起来，这通常意味着你用手做一个小碗或一个小人物，这样液体或食物就会适合里面，有点像一个小勺子。

segments.en: Or a little cup, that's right.
segments.zh: 或者一个小杯子，没错。

segments.en: So to scoop up, scoop something up.
segments.zh: 所以要舀起，舀一些东西。

segments.en: Alright so now let's go back, let's review this dialogue and when we come back we're going to take a look at the specific Indian dishes found in this dialogue.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们回顾一下，让我们回顾一下这个对话，当我们回来时，我们将看看这个对话中的特定印度菜肴。

segments.en: So where is this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
segments.zh: 那么我们要去的神秘餐厅在哪里呢？

segments.en: It's an Indian restaurant.
segments.zh: 那是一家印度餐厅。

segments.en: I know you have never had Indian food so I thought you might want to try it.
segments.zh: 我知道你从来没有吃过印度菜，所以我想你可能想尝尝。

segments.en: That sounds great.
segments.zh: 听起来很棒。

segments.en: I am craving some type of beef dish.
segments.zh: 我渴望某种类型的牛肉菜。

segments.en: Well Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度菜实际上不提供牛肉。

segments.en: You see cows are a sacred animal, a very important element in the Hindu religion so beef is not eaten.
segments.zh: 你看奶牛是一种神圣的动物，是印度教宗教中非常重要的元素，所以不吃牛肉。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So what are we having?
segments.zh: 那么我们有什么？

segments.en: Chicken?
segments.zh: 鸡肉？

segments.en: There are many amazing dishes to choose from.
segments.zh: 有许多令人惊叹的菜肴可供选择。

segments.en: We can have some chicken tikka masala which is an amazing curry.
segments.zh: 可以点一份玛萨拉烤鸡咖喱，味道非常棒。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，但我认为你可以处理它。

segments.en: Sounds good.
segments.zh: 听起来不错。

segments.en: I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
segments.zh: 我一直听说印度香料给食物带来了浓郁的味道。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We can have some naan bread which is baked in a tandoori oven.
segments.zh: 我们可以吃一些在唐杜里烤箱中烘烤的烤饼。

segments.en: Since you don't use any utensils to eat, you can use this bread to scoop up the curry or rice.
segments.zh: 由于您不使用任何餐具吃，因此您可以用这种面包舀起咖喱或米饭。

segments.zh: 蔬菜呢？

segments.en: Oh they have a good variety of vegetable based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable samosas or dal.
segments.zh: 蔬菜类菜肴也有很多，比如菠菜奶酪、蔬菜咖喱角和扁豆咖喱。

segments.en: It all sounds so exquisite.
segments.zh: 这一切听起来都很精致。

segments.en: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at those dishes on Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，现在让我们来看看语言外卖第 2 部分中的这些菜肴。

segments.en: Oh Marco these lessons are making me so hungry.
segments.zh: 哦，马可，这些课程让我如此饥饿。

segments.en: We've been doing them for a couple of weeks now and this one is no exception.
segments.zh: 我们已经做了几个星期了，这一个也不例外。

segments.en: We talked a little bit today about chicken dishes and vegetable dishes but a very general kind of dish in Indian food is a curry.
segments.zh: 我们今天谈了一些鸡肉菜肴和蔬菜菜肴，但印度菜中的一种非常普遍的菜肴是咖喱。

segments.en: That's right a curry.
segments.zh: 没错，咖喱。

segments.en: Now this is a naan and it's a dish that has a variety of spices in it.
segments.zh: 现在这是一道烤饼，它是一道含有多种香料的菜肴。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So there are many different flavors not just one flavor.
segments.zh: 所以有许多不同的口味，而不仅仅是一种口味。

segments.en: You can have chicken curries and vegetable curries and mutton or lamb curries but the thing that you need to remember in Indian food is that there's usually different colors of curry.
segments.zh: 你可以吃鸡肉咖喱和蔬菜咖喱、羊肉或羊肉咖喱，但你需要在印度食物中记住的是，咖喱的颜色通常不同。

segments.en: Red, yellow or green curries.
segments.zh: 红色、黄色或绿色咖喱。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So the dishes are usually called curries and an example of a curry we have a chicken tikka masala curry.
segments.zh: 所以这些菜通常被称为咖喱和咖喱鸡肉提卡马萨拉咖喱的例子。

segments.en: Okay so we know that there's chicken in it and tikka means that it's grilled chicken and masala is the name of the spice or the curry, the spice that's in that curry.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们知道里面有鸡肉，Tikka 的意思是烤鸡，马萨拉是香料或咖喱的名字，咖喱里的香料。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a curry is kind of like a thick sauce with pieces of chicken in it.
segments.zh: 所以咖喱有点像浓酱汁，里面有鸡块。

segments.en: In this case for the chicken tikka masala.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，鸡肉 tikka masala。

segments.en: It's a little bit spicy and it's a color red.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，是红色的。

segments.en: Alright so we've got the chicken tikka masala or masala and usually you eat this with rice or bread but in India there's a special, there are many different kinds of bread but the special bread we heard today was called naan bread.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们有鸡肉 tikka masala 或 masala，通常你用米饭或面包吃这个，但在印度有一种特殊的面包，有许多不同的面包，但我们今天听到的特殊面包被称为 naan 面包。

segments.en: Right naan bread and it's just basically a type of bread.
segments.zh: 对 naan 面包，它基本上只是一种面包。

segments.en: Now it's not like the bread that you usually have at home.
segments.zh: 现在它不像你通常在家里吃的面包。

segments.en: It's a flat bread so it kind of looks like a pancake almost.
segments.zh: 这是一个扁平面包，所以它看起来有点像煎饼。

segments.en: It does.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: It's not fluffy.
segments.zh: 它不蓬松。

segments.en: It's flat and the way they cook it is they use this special oven and they cook it inside the oven.
segments.zh: 它是平的，他们烹饪的方式是他们使用这个特殊的烤箱，他们在烤箱里煮。

segments.en: Now the question is what is that oven called Marco?
segments.zh: 现在的问题是那个烤箱叫做马可是什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The oven that we heard is a tandoori oven.
segments.zh: 我们听到的烤箱是唐杜里烤箱。

segments.en: Okay so tandoori is just the name of this oven.
segments.zh: 好吧，Tandoori 只是这个烤箱的名字。

segments.en: It's also a style of cooking in India and it's actually one of my favorite kinds of Indian food because you have this, these many different kinds of grilled meats.
segments.zh: 它也是印度的一种烹饪风格，它实际上是我最喜欢的印度菜之一，因为你有这个，这些不同种类的烤肉。

segments.en: You can have tandoori chicken, tandoori mutton, things like that.
segments.zh: 你可以吃唐杜里鸡肉，唐杜里羊肉，诸如此类。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a tandoori oven is a type of oven usually made from clay.
segments.zh: 所以唐杜里烤箱是一种通常由粘土制成的烤箱。

segments.en: That's why it's called tandoori.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么它被称为Tandoori。

segments.en: Now towards the end we also have some vegetarian options because as we heard in India they don't eat beef and many people are also vegetarians.
segments.zh: 现在到最后我们也有一些素食选择，因为我们在印度听说他们不吃牛肉，而且许多人也是素食者。

segments.en: They don't eat any type of meat at all.
segments.zh: 他们根本不吃任何类型的肉。

segments.en: So the first vegetable based dish that we heard is a palak paneer.
segments.zh: 所以我们听到的第一道蔬菜是 Palak Paneer。

segments.en: That's interesting actually because paneer is curd or like a cheese type of thing.
segments.zh: 这实际上很有趣，因为 Paneer 是凝乳或喜欢奶酪的东西。

segments.en: So it's usually white and comes in rectangles and paneer you can have many different flavors of it but paneer generally is a kind of a cheese, like a cottage cheese.
segments.zh: 所以它通常是白色的，有矩形和芝士，你可以有许多不同的口味，但芝士通常是一种奶酪，比如白软干酪。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And palak is actually spinach so it's a dish that it kind of looks like a thick sauce, green sauce which is made out of spinach and within it it has little pieces of this type of cheese.
segments.zh: Palak 实际上是菠菜，所以它看起来像是一种浓稠的酱汁，由菠菜制成的绿色酱汁，里面有这种奶酪的小块。

segments.en: I love this dish.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这道菜。

segments.en: It's very very delicious.
segments.zh: 它非常非常美味。

segments.en: We also have vegetable samosas.
segments.zh: 我们也有蔬菜萨摩萨。

segments.en: Now a samosa, what's that?
segments.zh: 现在是萨摩萨，那是什么？

segments.en: Now this is a great dish.
segments.zh: 现在这是一道很棒的菜。

segments.en: This is often used as an appetizer or as a snack.
segments.zh: 这通常用作开胃菜或小吃。

segments.en: You see these on carts or on the street in India.
segments.zh: 您可以在推车或印度街头看到这些。

segments.en: Now samosas are like pyramids or triangles and inside they have vegetables.
segments.zh: 现在萨摩萨就像金字塔或三角形，里面有蔬菜。

segments.en: So you can have potatoes and peas or lentils, no not lentils, you can have potatoes and peas and they're a little bit crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside and they're very tasty.
segments.zh: 所以你可以吃土豆和豌豆或小扁豆，没有不是扁豆，你可以吃土豆和豌豆，外面有点松脆，里面很软，而且很好吃。

segments.en: I guess the equivalent would be to, it's something like an egg roll.
segments.zh: 我想等效的是，它就像一个蛋卷。

segments.en: Like a dumpling.
segments.zh: 像饺子。

segments.en: Like a dumpling because it is deep fried.
segments.zh: 像饺子，因为它是油炸的。

segments.en: And we also have dal.
segments.zh: 我们也有达尔。

segments.en: So this is actually a type of lentil as you mentioned.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上是你提到的一种扁豆。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So dal is a lentil dish and it can be flavored in different ways but basically lentils are these very very very very small round things.
segments.zh: 所以木豆是一道扁豆，它可以用不同的方式调味，但基本上小扁豆是这些非常非常非常小的圆形的东西。

segments.en: They're very good for your health.
segments.zh: 它们对您的健康非常有益。

segments.en: And dal is a kind of a soupy lentil dish.
segments.zh: 木豆是一种汤扁豆。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So lentil is the category of this type of, I don't know if it's, it's not a grain.
segments.zh: 所以扁豆是这种类型的类别，我不知道它是否是，它不是一个谷物。

segments.en: It's a legume.
segments.zh: 是豆类。

segments.en: It's a legume exactly.
segments.zh: 完全是豆类。

segments.en: So it may sound a little bit weird but we'll post some pictures of different types of lentils because it's like saying potatoes.
segments.zh: 所以听起来可能有点奇怪，但我们会发布一些不同类型小扁豆的照片，因为这就像说土豆。

segments.en: There are many different types of potatoes.
segments.zh: 有许多不同类型的土豆。

segments.en: Sweet potato and all this.
segments.zh: 红薯和这一切。

segments.en: And the same thing goes with lentils.
segments.zh: 小扁豆也是如此。

segments.en: So we'll post some pictures so you can see what it looks like.
segments.zh: 所以我们会发布一些图片，这样你就可以看到它的样子。

segments.en: But now why don't we go back.
segments.zh: 但现在我们为什么不回去。

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue again.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次对话。

segments.en: Let's review everything and we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 让我们回顾一下一切，我们会马上回来的。

segments.en: So where is this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
segments.zh: 那么我们要去的神秘餐厅在哪里呢？

segments.en: It's an Indian restaurant.
segments.zh: 那是一家印度餐厅。

segments.en: I know you have never had Indian food so I thought you might want to try it.
segments.zh: 我知道你从来没有吃过印度菜，所以我想你可能想尝尝。

segments.en: That sounds great.
segments.zh: 听起来很棒。

segments.en: I am craving some type of beef dish.
segments.zh: 我渴望某种类型的牛肉菜。

segments.en: Well Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度菜实际上不提供牛肉。

segments.en: You see cows are a sacred animal, a very important element in the Hindu religion.
segments.zh: 你会看到奶牛是一种神圣的动物，是印度教中非常重要的元素。

segments.en: So beef is not eaten.
segments.zh: 所以牛肉不吃。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: So what are we having?
segments.zh: 那么我们有什么？

segments.en: Chicken?
segments.zh: 鸡肉？

segments.en: There are many amazing dishes to choose from.
segments.zh: 有许多令人惊叹的菜肴可供选择。

segments.en: We can have some chicken tikka masala which is an amazing curry.
segments.zh: 可以点一份玛萨拉烤鸡咖喱，味道非常棒。

segments.en: It's a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.
segments.zh: 它有点辣，但我认为你可以处理它。

segments.en: Sounds good.
segments.zh: 听起来不错。

segments.en: I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
segments.zh: 我一直听说印度香料给食物带来了浓郁的味道。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We can have some naan bread which is baked in a tandoori oven.
segments.zh: 我们可以吃一些在唐杜里烤箱中烘烤的烤饼。

segments.en: Since you don't use any utensils to eat, you can use this bread to scoop up the curry or rice.
segments.zh: 由于您不使用任何餐具吃，因此您可以用这种面包舀起咖喱或米饭。

segments.en: What about veggies?
segments.zh: 蔬菜呢？

segments.en: Oh they have a good variety of vegetable based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable samosas or dal.
segments.zh: 蔬菜类菜肴也有很多，比如菠菜奶酪、蔬菜咖喱角和扁豆咖喱。

segments.en: It all sounds so exquisite.
segments.zh: 这一切听起来都很精致。

segments.en: I can't wait.
segments.zh: 我等不及了。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So Indian food has a reputation of being spicy but it's very very delicious.
segments.zh: 所以印度食物以辣而闻名，但非常非常美味。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And you know what people always tell me, at least my Indian friends always tell me, is that saying Indian food is like saying Chinese food.
segments.zh: 你知道人们总是告诉我的，至少我的印度朋友总是告诉我，说印度菜就像说中国菜一样。

segments.en: We have some general idea but every different part of India has its own special foods.
segments.zh: 我们有一些大致的想法，但印度的每个不同地区都有自己的特殊食物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so what we get in America at Indian restaurants might not be the same as what we get at Indian restaurants in India.
segments.zh: 因此，我们在美国在印度餐厅获得的可能与我们在印度的印度餐馆获得的不同。

segments.en: So I just want to say that.
segments.zh: 所以我只想这么说。

segments.en: But generally you can find these dishes at any Indian restaurants in America.
segments.zh: 但一般来说，您可以在美国的任何印度餐馆找到这些菜肴。

segments.en: That's right actually if next time you're in an Indian restaurant or if you ever go, ask them from what region or what area of India the food is from.
segments.zh: 实际上，如果下次您在印度餐厅或您去过印度的哪个地区或地区，请询问他们来自印度的哪个地区或哪个地区，这是正确的。

segments.en: Because it may be Northern Indian cuisine and obviously that is going to be a little bit different than maybe the Southern.
segments.zh: 因为它可能是北印度美食，显然这可能与南方有点不同。

segments.en: I think the Southern is supposed to be spicier.
segments.zh: 我认为南方应该更辣。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And it's just like in every country.
segments.zh: 就像在每个国家一样。

segments.en: Even in our own home countries, maybe the food from the coast or from the North will be different from the South or the Inlands.
segments.zh: 即使在我们自己的祖国，来自海岸或北方的食物也可能与南方或内陆不同。

segments.en: And I just want to make one more comment.
segments.zh: 我只想再发表一篇评论。

segments.en: One of my favorite things to do that many Indian restaurants offer in America is the lunch buffet.
segments.zh: 许多印度餐馆在美国提供的最喜欢做的事情之一是自助午餐。

segments.en: So a buffet is basically a self-serve of food.
segments.zh: 所以自助餐基本上是自助餐。

segments.en: So the restaurant will put out many different dishes and you can take as much as you want of each but you pay one price.
segments.zh: 因此，餐厅会推出许多不同的菜肴，您可以随心所欲地拿走每种菜肴，但您要付出一份代价。

segments.en: So it's $11.99 or something.
segments.zh: 所以它是 11.99 美元之类的。

segments.en: That's very, very good.
segments.zh: 这是非常非常好的。

segments.en: And yeah, so I often do this when I'm home in the States and I just, you know, I get to pick my favorite dishes and I eat as much as I want.
segments.zh: 是的，所以当我在美国的家时，我经常这样做，我只是，你知道，我可以挑选我最喜欢的菜肴，我想吃多少就吃多少。

segments.en: And actually I think one other thing that's worth mentioning, we didn't mention in the dialogue but Indian sweets and the tea is very, very good.
segments.zh: 实际上，我认为另一件事值得一提，我们在对话中没有提到，但印度糖果和茶非常非常好。

segments.en: The milk tea that they drink in India is delicious and the sweets are very, very good.
segments.zh: 他们在印度喝的奶茶很好吃，糖果非常非常好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: They're famous for being very good and not very healthy for you.
segments.zh: 他们以非常好而闻名，对你来说不是很健康。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: They're very sweet.
segments.zh: 他们非常甜蜜。

segments.en: If you're in an Indian restaurant, take note.
segments.zh: 如果您在印度餐厅，请注意。

segments.en: Look for these different things and let us know.
segments.zh: 寻找这些不同的东西并告诉我们。

segments.zh: 你喜欢吃印度菜吗？

segments.zh: 再见。
